title: Frontend: findMaxNumber
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind findMaxNumber. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(values). Return {value,index} of the first maximum in a finite numeric array, or null for empty input.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Maintain the best value and index while scanning, replacing them only on a strict greater-than comparison to preserve the first tie.
alternativeApproaches: Adapt the accumulator to an async iterable and propagate cancellation and source failures.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: All negatives; repeated maximum; empty stream.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
